description: slack_message: text, thread_ts and channel are all CANONICAL keys. A message carrying thread_ts is posted as a reply inside that thread.
notes: Asserts the OUTBOUND CALL, not the step output, because the two are indistinguishable when this fails: a reply flattened to the root of the channel returns ok:true with the same fields. Which transport an implementation needs in order to honour the key is its own business — Nashira has two and only one of them can thread, so its adapter reaches for that one; the oracle has a single transport and its adapter does nothing special. A vector naming a transport would be a vector describing one product's plumbing.
